title: Research: independently bind QQ16 consumer budget to the first F0 caller
body:
## Result and scope

Independently confirms the fixed-profile obstruction in #3908 at head `0d8880e38ed7c88d70eec6a48e5aa829d0fb22f3` and binds it to the first F0 caller audited in #3932.

The raw producer programs and literal #2707 decoder word reproduce the profiles and 336 decoder calls per pair. A new rational midpoint/trapezoid logarithm enclosure gives an optimistic moment in **[1.000097677678, 1.000097678284]**, above one at the selected saving, even after all eight reported rank-eight children are waived. F0 event 9894 is exactly the L546 child; its prefix hash agrees with #3932. All 37 native cases receive a separate profile census.

The new decision evidence is a decoder/centre tradeoff:

- Under centre 64, at most 121 decoder rank-one calls per pair pass the favorable relaxation with rank-eight work waived, or 61 with it retained.
- A hypothetical centre 63 with all 336 decoder calls and rank-eight work retained passes only the optimistic screen, leaving about 0.0000126126 normalized allowance. No changed coverage construction or physical tariff follows.

Pause expansion of the unchanged recipe as a route to the selected target. The next bounded task is to pin an actual F17-native consumer demand, compose it with the literal decoder, identify real eliminated work and derive a changed complete invoice. Scalar/axis speed alone does not delete a recursive charge; a proved all-depth direct-tape replacement is a separately priced changed premise. No global QQ16 barrier, physical caller admission, complete supplier or new kappa is claimed.

## Contribution and workflow

Only `research/qq16-consumer-budget-independent/` is added: 11 files. Canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6, was refreshed during the session; instruction/priority/catalogue/selected/family guidance is unchanged. This is an explicit assignment. Targeted live PR and Discussion overlap was checked; the repository helper lacked gh, so remote coverage is partial.

The original seven-file #3908 package is retained byte-identically in an archive for actual offline replay, with hashes and attribution. Standalone scripts need no unmerged Git objects. Frozen inputs, shared verifiers and selected science are unchanged.

Publication head: `8dec5c663ace6285aeee49ec3f8eeae9a8bc9a58`.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -I -Werror -B research/qq16-consumer-budget-independent/verify.py
python3 -I -O -Werror -B research/qq16-consumer-budget-independent/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-consumer-budget-independent
```

Local CPython 3.12.3 normal/optimized warning-strict checks pass: eleven behavioral groups, exact predecessor replay, source/semantic/receipt failures and a read-only Git-free export. Registered replay and metadata checks pass. Published-byte plus source-history preflight passes at the head above for 18 files; diff whitespace checks pass. The original #3908 registered replay and previously unrun source-history preflight also pass at its exact head (12 files). VERIFICATION.json records actual runs; hosted checks are separate.

Full inherited native/bridge/decoder algebra, huge payload execution, selected cold replay, Lean, physical invoice and independent human review remain unrun.

Credit 1337isnot1337/#3908 for the obstruction; dcharb78/#3181 for its profile/cost screen; ywz65/#2707; Ali Romman and the conserved QQ16/native lineage; Douglas Colkitt and coverage-ceiling authors; Sagar Thakrar and the coverage identity lineage; Nick Petalas and retained source notices.

Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance. Apache-2.0. This adds independent checking and thresholds, not the predecessor theorem. README.md, PROOF.md and TASK.json give the changed-consumer handoff and stopping rule, with adjacent #2391/#2461/#3120/#3873 scopes kept distinct.
